title_sq: Tek Kompleksi Turdiu, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Hapesira Te Bollshme !!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi Turdiu, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Hapesira Te Bollshme!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 11 te njeres prej godinave dhe organizohet nga korridori, salloni ndenjes me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet me vete, dhoma e femijeve, tualeti dites dhe nje dhome garderobe pa dritare, qe mund te sherbeje dhe si dhome gjumi. Pallati aktualisht eshte ne fazen perfundimtare te punimeve dhe pritet te dorezohet shume shpejt. Kompleksi dhe Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode. Njekohesisht apartamenti ka ne dispozicion nje post parkimi ne katin -1, me vlere ekstra 25.000 euro.
title_en: At the Turdiu Complex, Super Apartment 2+1+2, With Ample Spaces for Sale!!
description_en: At the Turdiu Complex, Super Apartment 2+1+2, With Ample Spaces for Sale!! The apartment is located on the 11th floor of one of the buildings and is organized by a corridor, a living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, a matrimonial room with its own toilet, a children's room, a day toilet and a wardrobe room without windows, which can also be used as a bedroom. The palace is currently in the final stage of works and is expected to be delivered very soon. The complex and the area in which the apartment is located offer all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. At the same time, the apartment has available a parking post on the -1st floor, with an extra value of 25,000 euros.
